bridge.sentence: Jul 2026: Profit +€17k but cash +€111k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €69k, collecting more than was invoiced; €23k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €124k paid to tax authority; €106k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Aug 2026: Profit +€130k but cash €132k — customers owed €275k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €67k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €101k paid to tax authority; €160k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Sep 2026: Profit +€79k but cash €648k — customers owed €1,295k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €287k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €125k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €425k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Oct 2026 (forecast): Profit €59k but cash +€422k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €370k, collecting more than was invoiced; €71k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €68k paid to tax authority; €87k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Nov 2026 (forecast): Profit +€59k but cash €28k — customers reduced their outstanding balance by €117k, collecting more than was invoiced; €205k more paid to suppliers than newly invoiced; VAT of €96k paid to tax authority; €76k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).

Dec 2026 (forecast): Profit €235k but cash +€277 — customers owed €529k more at month-end (invoiced but not yet collected); €476k in new supplier invoices not yet paid (temporary cash buffer); VAT of €125k paid to tax authority; quarterly tax advance of €40k paid; €432k timing benefit (e.g. payroll accrual).
